messages:
Aisha (CSM): Heads up — MeridianCare renewal flagged. Usage down ~45% over last 30d after their EHR vendor rolled out v3. Champion (Dr. Patel) left last week. They just kicked off a competitor pilot. Need triage + quick recovery plan.
Diego (AE): Noted. I'll reach out to procurement + the new PM. Can we get a short health packet for them before Wed? Also recommend offering a 60-day trial extension to keep them in-prod.
Nora (SE): I can pull product-level usage and latencies. Can someone confirm the customer org_id (meridiancare-prod)? If yes, I'll run queries now.
Riley (Support): Confirm org_id = meridiancare-prod. Quick scan shows error rate spike on /ingest and /embed endpoints starting 2026-03-02. Attached small log snippet:
```
2026-03-02T14:12:03Z ERROR /ingest 502 upstream-timeout user=meridiancare
2026-03-02T14:12:07Z WARN  /embed 429 rate-limit user=meridiancare
```
Aisha (CSM): OK thanks. Nora — please prioritize: 1) 7d active user trend, 2) top 5 endpoints by volume, 3) error vs success rates.
Nora (SE): On it. Quick SQL I'm running:
```
SELECT endpoint, count(*) AS calls, avg(latency_ms) AS avg_ms, sum(case when status >=500 then 1 else 0 end) AS errors
FROM request_logs
WHERE org_id = 'meridiancare-prod' AND ts >= now() - INTERVAL '30 days'
GROUP BY endpoint
ORDER BY calls DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
Diego (AE): I'll draft a one-page win-back note: impact summary + proposed credits + enablement session. Can @Aisha share their primary contact email?
Aisha (CSM): New PM is Casey Li — casey.li@meridiancare.org. I've pinged them for a 30-min sync tomorrow (options: 10am or 3pm PT).
Riley (Support): Support ticket created: CS-8421 (investigate /ingest 502s). I've attached request traces and correlated deploys — looks like their EHR vendor changed request shapes which caused retries and 429s.
Aisha (CSM): Suggest actions: 
- Offer 60-day extension + 25% reserved credits for dedicated pool (Diego)
- Emergency enablement + integration POV call with SE (Nora)
- Support ticket + trace handoff (Riley)
- QBR scheduling + exec slide for renewal discussion (Aisha)
Diego (AE): I can own the credits and exec slide. Will also prepare a short competitive brief on feature parity.
Nora (SE): Analysis quick take: top 3 endpoints dropped: /autocomplete -38%, /embed -52%, /summarize -19%. Error concentration on older client SDKs using legacy payloads. Recommend patching client or routing fallback to our compatibility model.
Aisha (CSM): Great. Action owners set: Diego (credits + slide), Nora (integration play + call), Riley (support ticket), Aisha (QBR invite + stakeholder outreach).
ops-bot: Ticket CS-8421 linked to account meridiancare-prod; case created and team assigned.
Aisha (CSM): I'll send the win-back note + invite after Diego reviews. Please add any blockers to this thread. :thumbsup:
Diego (AE): Reviewing now. If we get commitment on the enablement call, I'll propose a 30-day pilot rollback window instead of full renewal pause.
Nora (SE): FYI — I can do a 60-min deep-dive demo of integration best practices tomorrow at 3pm PT if that works for them.
Aisha (CSM): Scheduled: synced with Casey for 3pm PT tomorrow. Closing internal triage — follow-ups will be tracked on CS-8421 and the QBR deck.
Aisha (CSM): Update: after the call (2026-03-04), Casey wants the extension and an integration checklist. They've paused the competitor pilot for now. Marking this as at-risk -> recovery-in-progress.
